description: Issue #181: the companion an aggregate contract test IS. `scripts/tests/shared-contract.test.mjs` checks several modules at once, so its NAME corresponds to no source name — L1 cannot reach it (it derives the four conventional shapes of each declared `.mjs` and stops) and `derive` cannot express it either, because every `derive` add must be a function of the declared path. It is declared as a LITERAL under `require`, and this case pins the three things that makes true: the literal reaches `scope_defaults` (hence `suspected_files`, hence the worker's scope.allow) when a declared path matches a rule's `when`; it appears exactly ONCE even though both declared paths match a rule (the second is deduplicated against `have`, so it does not eat two of dispatch's 200 scope slots); and it COEXISTS with the placeholder form — the same profile's `derive` rule contributes `scripts/tests/build-tiles.test.mjs`, and L1's eight shapes are untouched. Diff against 63: same profile, an issue whose files match no `when`.
